<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY ent 'ExpandedEntity'>">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext-img SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment containing an entity reference and PI -->
  <?target-pi data="test"?>
  <sub:child id="node1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block enclosing <tags> and &ent; references safely.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY internal "DataChunk">
  <!ENTITY complex "&internal; &internal;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY report SYSTEM "annual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ELEMENT meta EMPTY>">
  %macro;
]>
<?xml-app-logger level="DEBUG"?>
<enterprise xmlns="http://xml.company.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://xml.company.org/meta">
  <!-- Processing complex nested entity expansions inside elements -->
  <section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Strictly parsed CDATA section: &complex; -- not expanded here.
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&complex;</section>
</enterprise>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY token "AlphaBeta">
  <!ENTITY combined "&token;&token;">
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY poster SYSTEM "poster.tif" NDATA tiff>
  <!ENTITY % ext_dtd SYSTEM "http://example.org/dtd-ext.dtd">
  %ext_dtd;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="validation" status="active"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/schema" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment reviewing CDATA and namespace prefix collision behavior -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      <catalog><item>Nested pseudo-xml inside CDATA</item></catalog>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&combined;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY core "CoreValue">
  <!ENTITY reference "&core; plus extra">
  <!NOTATION text-plain SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY logfile SYSTEM "system.log" NDATA text-plain>
  <!ENTITY % local_attr "id ID #REQUIRED">
  <!ATTLIST record %local_attr;>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://archive.org/ns/custom">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA block testing parser robustness -->
  <record id="r_01">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw text data with unparsed entities like &reference; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record id="r_02">&reference;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE registry [
  <!ELEMENT registry (entry)*>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY tokenA "ValueA">
  <!ENTITY tokenB "&tokenA; and ValueB">
  <!NOTATION mp3 SYSTEM "audio/mpeg">
  <!ENTITY sound SYSTEM "track.mp3" NDATA mp3>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-param "<!ENTITY param-ent 'ParameterEntityValue'>">
  %dtd-param;
]>
<?xml-metrics tracking="enabled"?>
<registry xmlns="http://registry.org/net" xmlns:ext="http://registry.org/net/ext">
  <!-- Comment emphasizing extreme edge combinations of CDATA, PI, and entities -->
  <?ext:pi command="init"?>
  <entry>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing &param-ent; and other strings.
    ]]>
  </entry>
  <entry>&tokenB;</entry>
</registry>
```
